verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no marketplace of ready-made, runnable scrapers. The only related item is "30+ ready-made templates", which are starter code for building your own automation, an adjacent feature rather than a marketplace of scrapers you can run directly. Browserbase otherwise provides browser infrastructure, SDKs and agent tooling for building scrapers yourself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a ready-made scraper from a marketplace instead of building one from scratch
